title: Unlocking Robust Semantic Segmentation Performance via Label-only Elastic Deformations against Implicit Label Noise (NSegment+)
mechanism: Elastic deformation applied to labels only (image untouched), resampled every epoch, to model implicit boundary noise; small segments exempted.
adaptation: Invert the small-object rule: apply smooth 0.5 to 1.5 px deformation to crack and inactive labels only (sigma 4 to 8 px, p 0.5), never to structural classes. One dataloader change.
min_experiment: Arm: house + label-only jitter. Baseline: house. Metric: crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill if both < house + 0.005. About 6 GPU-h.
evidence: R: mIoU +2.29 Vaihingen, +2.38 LoveDA, +1.75 Cityscapes, +3.39 VOC; vs LNL methods with DeepLabV3+: +0.81 Vaihingen, +0.63 Cityscapes, beating AIO2, L2B, UCE, Compensation Learning.
prior_overlap: partial: offset-tolerant CE (n.d.) also targets shift tolerance; label-only stochastic jitter is a different regulariser and untested.
